source: Volume I, printed pages 61 (study 8) and 76 (study 12); private user-supplied source pages; source scans not published
method: symbol-first: staff geometry, source-font templates, vertical/horizontal morphology, notation rules
validation_note: Visual symbol-count audit on the two calibration samples. This is not blinded evaluation on unseen book pages and is not a note-by-note performance certificate.

rhythmic_decoding.reason: beams and duration on each staff not yet decoded independently

limitations: Templates calibrated on p61 symbols and near-identical raster scale
Notehead candidate center can be displaced by staff lines and stems; pitches not yet reliable
Hollow candidates identified via unattached stems but duration still needs direct head inspection
Upper/lower staff candidates are detected, but independent full polyphony not decoded
Unseen-page test revealed spurious matches: no book-wide automation approved
No automatic output should be published as a verified playable lesson at this stage
